ODSTextBody extends the native HTMLDivElement properties as React props. On top of the additional properties that are listed below, you can also pass the native HTMLDivElement properties as React props. You can read more about those properties here.


Name	Description	Default	Control
text	
The text content to display in the body.
string
-	

ODSTextBody is a Preferred Content component that can be used inside ODSAccordion via the contentSlot prop. It provides a ready-made layout, making it useful as a common pattern for ODSAccordion. This component is not the default content — developers must pass it explicitly to the contentSlot of ODSAccordion. It can also be replaced entirely with any custom React content when more flexibility is needed.

For detailed guidelines, please visit the Accordion Documentation.
